tasks.label: Mountable shaft support
tasks.request: Shortlist a stationary mountable body for supporting a rotating shaft, with visible circular bearing-seat or carrier geometry and mounting features. Exclude bare rotating shafts, generic pipe flanges and fasteners. Preliminary geometric discovery only.

rules.shortlist: Stationary carrier with a visible circular support seat and mounting features.
rules.conditional: Plausible support body but seat or mounting interpretation is unresolved.
rules.reject: Shaft, generic pipe flange, fastener or visibly incompatible support form.

tasks.label: Complete shaft connection
tasks.request: Shortlist a complete mechanical shaft-connection component with positive evidence of two coaxial shaft attachment regions or a keyed/clamping continuous connection. A hollow reducer alone is insufficient positive evidence. No torque or fit certification requested.

rules.shortlist: Complete connection form with two coaxial shaft attachment regions, or clear keyed/clamping connection evidence.
rules.conditional: Plausible coupling form with one attachment region or retention feature unresolved.
rules.reject: No positive shaft attachment evidence; generic hollow reducer or unrelated part.

features.label: Two coaxial shaft attachment regions or a keyed/clamping connection
Positive shaft attachment evidence; more than a plain reducer

tasks.label: Belt-contact wheel
tasks.request: Shortlist a rotating belt-contact wheel with a recognizable circumferential groove or belt-type tooth/flange geometry. A generic toothed wheel is only conditional without profile evidence; springs, bolts and plain mating flanges do not meet this scope.

rules.shortlist: Wheel with a recognizable belt groove or belt-type tooth/flange geometry.
rules.conditional: Toothed wheel whose belt-versus-gear interface remains ambiguous.
rules.reject: Plain mating flange, spring, bolt or wheel with an incompatible contact form.

features.label: Circumferential groove or recognizable belt-contact tooth form
Belt interface distinguishable from generic gear teeth

tasks.label: Headed threaded clamping
tasks.request: Shortlist a headed external-thread fastener for a preliminary clamped-joint design.

rules.shortlist: Head bearing surface and externally modeled helical thread on shank.
rules.conditional: Headed shank with simplified smooth thread representation; thread remains unverified.
rules.reject: Headless set screws, smooth pins without a head, nuts, hooks and non-fasteners.

features.label: Fastener head with a bearing surface

tasks.label: Nut retention
tasks.request: Shortlist a standalone wrenchable internally threaded nut to retain an external-thread fastener.

rules.shortlist: Internal thread visibly modeled with wrench flats or an explicit turning feature.
rules.conditional: Wrenchable bored nut-like body but internal thread absent or concealed in views.
rules.reject: Externally threaded bolts, smooth washers, large pipe flanges and plain sleeves.

tasks.label: Fixed bracket mounting
tasks.request: Shortlist a fixed bracket offering mounting features on two orthogonal or offset attachment faces.

rules.shortlist: Connected rigid angled or offset faces, with mounting holes or slots on two attachment regions.
rules.conditional: Plausible mounting body but second attachment region or holes are ambiguous.
rules.reject: Articulating hinges, single flat plates without another attachment region, rods and wheels.

features.label: Two angled or offset attachment regions
Mounting holes or slots in both regions

tasks.label: Bolted passage flange
tasks.request: Shortlist a flange-like part with a central passage, flat mating face and surrounding bolt holes for a preliminary passage connection.

rules.shortlist: Central open passage, surrounding bolt-hole pattern and a raised or recessed coaxial mating region.
rules.conditional: Flat bored bolt-circle plate or flange-like part without a clear mating register; fluid service is unverified.
rules.reject: Blind center, keyed shaft hubs without a passage role, threaded fasteners and toothed wheels.

features.label: Raised or recessed coaxial mating region

tasks.label: External gear meshing
tasks.request: Shortlist an external spur or helical cylindrical gear for preliminary parallel-axis gear meshing.

rules.shortlist: Visible repeated external spur/helical gear teeth and a cylindrical gear body.
rules.conditional: Toothed wheel with ambiguous gear-versus-belt tooth form; dimensions for a mate remain unknown.
rules.reject: Grooved pulley, flange-confined fine belt teeth, bevel-only gears, worm-only elements and smooth wheels.

features.label: Repeated external spur or helical teeth
Tooth form distinguishable from a belt pulley, bevel gear or worm

tasks.label: Rotary shaft transmission
tasks.request: Shortlist an elongated shaft with visible rotational drive features for preliminary motion transmission.

rules.shortlist: Elongated journal body with keyway, spline, gear, crank/eccentric geometry or opposed drive features.
rules.conditional: Smooth or simply stepped round rod that may be a shaft but has no positive drive feature.
rules.reject: Thread-only linear screw, headed fastening screw, short hollow coupling and flat bracket.

features.label: Keyway, spline, gear, crank or other positive rotational drive feature

tasks.label: Axial compression spring
tasks.request: Shortlist a helical spring body with visible coil travel and axial seating ends to resist compression.

rules.shortlist: Open-pitch helical coil, cylindrical/conical/barrel form, with axial ends and no extension hooks or torsion arms.
rules.conditional: Hook-free coil with pitch or seating/end geometry unclear, or a spring assembly with travel concealed.
rules.reject: Hook-ended tension coils, torsion coils with projecting arms, flat clips and solid threaded rods.

features.label: Axial seating ends without extension hooks or torsion arms

tasks.label: Axial tension return spring
tasks.request: Shortlist a helical extension spring with two visible hooks or loops to provide a pulling return force.

rules.shortlist: Helical coil body with two opposed hooks or loops usable as attachment regions.
rules.conditional: Helical spring with only one visible hook, or an assembled extension-like form with the second interface concealed.
rules.reject: Bare open compression coil with no tensile attachments, torsion arms and flat clips.

features.label: Ends form tensile attachment regions rather than torsion arms
